coverage: Documented variants containing the selected card in Commander Spellbook. This is a bounded source snapshot, not every possible combo. Color compatibility alone is not association.
ranking: Estimated strength: potential winning/damage/combat outcomes first, then other infinite engines, then other outcomes. Ties prefer fewer required pieces, then less stated setup mana, then stable source ID. Infinite mana is not automatically a win. This heuristic ignores interaction, consistency and metagame; it is not a deck power rating. Spellbook category labels are subjective source categories, not numerical ratings.
